🎥🎬: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The legendary Vermont State Troopers are back, and somehow they’re causing even more chaos than ever before. When a routine investigation turns into a bizarre case involving outrageous criminals, clueless suspects, and their own unconventional policing methods, the team must rely on equal parts luck, friendship, and absolute nonsense to save the day.

With the return of the original cast, Super Troopers 3 brings back the franchise’s signature pranks, unforgettable one-liners, and nonstop laughs that fans have been waiting years to see. Packed with ridiculous situations, wild encounters, and the hilarious chemistry that made the series a comedy classic, this latest chapter proves the troopers still haven’t lost their touch.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
